about: Where the pipeline finds the readings on tei (docs/PIPELINE.md). Paths are tei's. 'transkribus' is the ingest of Transkribus collection 2329424, imported by scripts/import_transkribus.py (it writes readings/pages.tsv, the list of pages, and the PyLaia reading). A run directory is an atr-batch run (<run>/<model>/<page key>.json); a jsonl glob holds {key, text} per line; with "reader": null the reader is the name of the file's folder (UBELIX writes ubelix/<model>/shard-*.jsonl). Collected pages are merged into readings/<reader>.jsonl, never removed. A source that does not exist yet is skipped.
